newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher, tempered by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher, tempered by Wall Street.

text.p: MADRID, Feb 25 (Reuter) 1630 GMT - Madrid stocks ended higher following major European markets with gains in almost all sectors. The market ended off the day's highs, pulled down by a soft tone on Wall Street, dealers said.
* General index up 3.16 points, 0.68 percent to 467.41
* Telefonica up 15 ptas to 3,255, Endesa up 160 pta to 8,670
* Repsol adds 50 pesetas to 5,580 after news the privatisation of the government's final 10 percent stake may be sooner than originally anticipated
Dealers predicted continued volatility in the short term.
"The trend in foreign markets has calmed Spanish stocks but in the short term we are going to continue the fluctuations seen in the last sessions," one dealer said.
Volume was moderate with 58.2 billion pesetas changing hands.
Electronics producer Amper was the leading gainer on the Ibex with an 8.3 percent rise and almost 950,000 shares traded.
Most of the large banks were up less than one percent. Santander was the top performer with a 1.78 percent gain.
